English: Tether Post
A basic set of wooden posts and rope lines used to secure small groups of reindeer upon arrival in new territory. Provides minimal organization for herd management.
Herding Patch
A small, cleared area with makeshift fencing and simple windbreaks, used to concentrate and manage larger groups of reindeer.
Snow Shelter
A collection of low, snow-packed shelters and bark-covered lean-tos for protecting reindeer from the harshest winter winds.
Reindeer Fold
A semi-permanent fold built from sturdy timber and reinforced snowbanks, designed to house and protect substantial herds through the winter season.
Fenced Pen
A large, well-constructed wooden pen with double gates and watch platforms, allowing for efficient herd management and defense against predators.
Breeders Hut
A specialized log cabin for expert breeders, with adjacent calving pens and storage for medicinal herbs, increasing herd fertility and manpower.
Reindeer Pavilion
A grand, multi-tent complex with decorated poles and communal fire pits, serving as both a breeding center and a meeting ground for clan leaders to oversee herd prosperity.
Antler Hall
A ceremonial longhouse adorned with reindeer antlers, symbolizing unity and prosperity. Used for feasts, council gatherings, and ritual celebrations.
Winter Grazing Yard
A vast, well-fenced expanse for grazing reindeer even in deep winter, with food storage pits and patrol shelters ensuring supply and security.
Finno-Ugric Reindeer Sanctuary
A sacred, protected reserve where the largest and most revered herds are kept under the watch of elders and shamans, symbolizing the spiritual heart of the clan.
